about: Manual scoring of each 5-minute run against samples/interview.facts.json (DRAFT facts, not yet confirmed by a person). 1 = captured, 0.5 = partly captured, 0 = missed. The 32-minute runs repeat the same call six times, so only their timing is used. Scored by Claude by reading the saved outputs in this folder.
